import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { SaleService } from 'src/app/services/sale.service'; import { Sale } from 'src/app/models/sale.model'; @Component({ selector: 'app-sale-list', templateUrl: './sale-list.component.html', styleUrls: ['./sale-list.component.css'], }) export class SaleListComponent implements OnInit { sales: Sale[] = []; constructor(private saleService: SaleService) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.loadSales(); } loadSales() { this.saleService.getSales().subscribe((data) => { this.sales = data; }); } deleteSale(id: number) { if (confirm('Are you sure to delete this sale?')) { this.saleService.deleteSale(id).subscribe(() => this.loadSales()); } } }
